crossRefs.note: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
Wake up righteously, and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he…
We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we…
The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of…

translations.web: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?
translations.bsb: I say this to your shame. Is there really no one among you wise enough to arbitrate between his brothers?
translations.kjv: I speak to your shame. Is it so, that there is not a wise man among you? no, not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren?
translations.asv: I say this to move you to shame. What, cannot there be found among you one wise man who shall be able to decide between his brethren,
